title: Product Service Provider's Obligation to Provide Service of Required Quality

content.scenario: A consumer, Karan, hired a contractor to build a house, but the contractor used substandard materials, resulting in a poorly constructed house that did not meet the quality required by the contract.
content.outcome: The contractor is liable for not providing a service of the quality required by the contract. The consumer (Karan) can file a complaint against the contractor for product liability, as the service provider did not meet their obligation to provide a service of the required quality.

user_queries: What are the obligations of a product service provider regarding quality?
Can a consumer file a complaint for poor quality service?
What happens if a service does not meet the contract requirements?
